chunks: And the owner of the sacrifice is forgiven at the very first drop that falls from its blood.

key_terms.الْأُضْحِيَّةِ: the sacrificial animal offered as an act of worship
key_terms.صَاحِبِ: the owner or one responsible for the offering

ai.seo_question: What reward is given to the one who offers the sacrifice?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great spiritual merit of offering the udhiyah in the context of hajj. It teaches that forgiveness is granted to the one offering the sacrifice from the moment its blood first falls.
